rationale.observed_best: Sibling propagation with fallback passed supported accuracy, near-domain rejection, false-route, invalid/error, and paired mean-latency gates, gaining 29 correct cases with zero paired losses.
rationale.remaining_failure: Its only failed gate was p95 latency because 42 propagation abstentions invoked the existing semantic/capability/BGE stack after an initial BGE call.
rationale.design_response: Reuse the already-computed global semantic graph ranking and score top-ranked authorized routes plus seed-tool siblings in one selective BGE batch. If that bounded BGE abstains, fail closed instead of invoking a second BGE path.

frozen_geometry.propagation_scope: semantic-ranked registered routes plus seed-tool siblings

measurement.note: The selective BGE batch is a single call over the bounded ranked graph surface; no existing-stack fallback is permitted after its abstention.

selection_rule.primary: highest harmonic mean of supported-operation routed accuracy and near-domain unsupported rejection among all-gate passers
selection_rule.no_winner: Proceed to explicit graph negative-evidence/corroboration development. Do not generate calibration or v15.
